reviews.text:
It seems that for Maxizoo, there are top-tier pets that deserve to be fed (dogs and cats), and then everything else they leave you to fend for yourself. And they call themselves a "pet shop."

So if you have turtles, birds, fish, or any other exotic pets, don't waste your time at this store.
Great store and fantastic saleswoman! Romi helped us right up to the checkout and was very helpful.
I was given excellent advice by Romy; of all the large zoos in Lyon, this is the one where I received the best welcome 🫶🏼 …
So glad to see pet shops back in town!!
Very nice and helpful staff. The store has a good proposition of products even when its not the biggest aMaxi Zoo.

Thanks to the whole 4pm team, including Romy who took our payment (we don't know everyone else's names)! The service was impeccable, as always, with great advice and really attractive prices with the offers. We highly recommend them!

A very large pet shop in the center of Lyon with a huge selection! I love going there to spoil my two cats with treats and toys, and I always find something for them. The staff are also very friendly and welcoming!
Shop exclusively for dogs and cats (nothing for aquariums)

Hello,

Thank you for these 5 wonderful stars that make our team's eyes light up. We are delighted to have provided you with a satisfying experience during your visits to our store.

Have a lovely day and see you soon,
The Maxi Zoo France Team
We received excellent advice from the salesperson Clément! Thank you to him for his advice regarding our cats 🐈‍⬛ …

Always a warm welcome in this shop and extremely happy that Maxizoo outlets are finally opening in town and this one in particular because you can find everything there, the shop is close to the metro which allows for more frequent visits, the staff are charming and my dog ​​loves their treats.
So cute!
Great ❤️ And we need to relax in the comments, right? 🤣❤️😍❤️😍 …

Finally, a pet shop with much more than attractive prices right in the heart of Rue Victor Hugo. I invite you to watch the videos because I bought all the products and supplies for Marquise Rose De Bellecour there. Marquise is a bourgeois and capricious cat who only likes the good things. When I don't come back from a walk with a treat, she sulks! She looks at me condescendingly, and the sulk can last a long time! She used to wake me up in the middle of the night with pâté so I would turn on the tap and she could play with the water! Come on, Rose! We're in the middle of a heatwave! You don't play with water! Concerned for her well-being, I rushed out to buy her a water fountain! 💦 with a filter! New bowls and some treats! She sniffed her new spot and seems to have gotten bored! You need to rethink your training, Rosette! Thank you to the saleswoman ❤️❤️❤️❤️😍😍😍😍😍

Excellent experience! A big thank you to the saleswoman with the tattoos for her warm welcome, kindness, and helpful advice. She was able to provide me with all the information I needed and answer all my questions. It's always a pleasure to receive such a warm welcome in a store.

I received a very warm welcome during my visit. I wasn't familiar with this store, but I'll definitely be back. The location is fantastic, and the advice was spot-on for my 3-year-old Staffordshire Bull Terrier, especially regarding food.
Great store! Can't wait to go back!

I was personally surprised; I rarely receive such good advice compared to all the competition, who are quick to try and sell us based on our profile. It's astonishing to find that ordinary salespeople are better able to explain things to me than many professionals who are just trying to sell us something for their own gain!
A new pet store in town, more accessible for residents. The staff is very welcoming, and there's a wide selection of accessories and food for both dogs and cats, so there's something for everyone.
I went to this store today, they're super cute and have a wide selection of products for dogs and cats, it's great!

I'm so happy with this shop in the city center; it's really great to have so much choice for my little cat! They recommended a fantastic range of products, which my kitty tried right away! She loves it, I highly recommend it, and the staff are super friendly!

Hello,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to see your rating and would like to better understand the reasons for your dissatisfaction. Please feel free to update your review to tell us more about your in-store experience; this will help us improve our service.

Have a good day.

The Maxi Zoo France Team

A very bad first experience, on the very day of opening.

I came looking for a specific product to treat my cat's fleas and explained exactly what I needed. However, I was told the product didn't exist, even though it was right there in front of us. Then, I was advised to get a product that doesn't kill fleas. After checking the label and explaining that it wasn't the right product, I was still told I was wrong. A colleague was finally called over and gave me the product I had been asking for from the start.

At the checkout, I asked to use the priority line with my card. The cashier was particularly rude and asked the next customer if she would mind if I went ahead of her, even though I had priority. I found this attitude truly inappropriate and humiliating.

I understand that mistakes can happen on opening day, but the welcome and attitude of the staff really disappointed me.
